description: Make the edit fit a target length (e.g. 45-min cut → 30 min, or 3:12 → 2:59) in one revision: removes pauses and filler words, then the weakest sentences (with a transcript), then the weakest shots, then trims each shot toward its strongest part. Hook and finale protected. dryRun shows the result without saving.
name: studio_fit_duration
